newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Cullinan says in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Cullinan says in merger talks.

text.p: South African industrial holdings firm Cullinan Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that it was in talks with prospective merger partners.
The firm said it was hoping any merger would bring new management control and forward direction following recent large losses.
The firm posted a half year loss to December 31, 1996, of 29 million rand.
Cullinan said that negotiations would end soon and a further detailed announcement made then.
The group's recent loss stemmed partly from a seven million rand loss at its engineering unit from unrecovered contract variables and overehads.
The group also saw a five million rand loss from a lack of throughput and production under-recoveries at its industrial porcelain operation.
Cullinan said it had received an offer at net asset value for a section of its engineering business and arrangements were also being finalised for the partial disposal of its electrical division.
These moves would help reduce group borrowings that stood at 72 million rand at the half year.

"As a consequence of the proposed merger, a new growth impetus would be established, based on Cullinan's existing core ceramics businesses and the substantial assets that would be introduced," the firm said in a statement.
